newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec, Thai JV fridge plant opens.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec, Thai JV fridge plant opens.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Electronics Co said on Friday its $20 million joint-venture refrigerator plant in Thailand had begun operations.
Daewoo has a 30 percent stake in the joint venture to make 100,000 refrigerators a year while its Thai partner Distar Electric Corp Pcl owns 70 percent.
A Daewoo statement said that it planned to double the factory's annual production capacity next year and that it was considering building an electric washing machine plant there.
Daewoo Electronics is a unit of the Daewoo Group and one of South Korea's top three home electronics makers.
